business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Self-described as an execution partner to larger EPC players rather than a standalone developer: "delivering critical execution support to leading EPC players" and providing "comprehensive, end-to-end solutions for complex project erection and integrated site construction requirements".
- Diversification is the stated defence against cyclicality: "a proven track record across multiple infrastructure segments" gives "diversified execution experience that strengthens its ability to navigate market cycles and industry fluctuations".
- Six business segments named: Civil and Electrical Infrastructure Project, Civic Utilities, Water Infrastructure Development Project, Mining Development Operations, Transportation, and Equipment Rental & Leasing.
- Client base is largely government and PSU-linked — Northern Coalfields Ltd, Odisha Mining Corporation Ltd, Indian Railways / Southeastern Railway, Jal Jeevan Mission (UP), and the "Har Ghar Jal Mission" in Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh, where the company is a sub-contractor.
- The CMD cites client validation: "The appreciation received from the client during the inspection of our Doodh Ganga Water Supply Project (DG-1) in Jammu & Kashmir reflects the trust we have built through quality execution".

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Leverage stated as "1.22x Debt/Equity (As of Mar'26)" in the Company Snapshot.
- Consolidated borrowings stepped up sharply in FY26: Long Term Borrowings ₹146.1 Crs (Mar-26) vs ₹3.0 Crs (Mar-25) and Short Term Borrowings ₹348.3 Crs vs ₹34.9 Crs; standalone Long Term Borrowings were only ₹3.3 Crs and Short Term ₹130.6 Crs, so most of the incremental debt sits below the standalone entity.
- Growth is consuming cash: consolidated Net Cash from Operating Activities was -₹40.9 Crs (Mar-26) and -₹80.1 Crs (Mar-25), on Changes in Working Capital of -₹122.8 Crs and -₹119.6 Crs, funded by Cash Flow from Financing Activities of ₹85.8 Crs and ₹109.5 Crs.
- Working capital intensity: consolidated Trade Receivables ₹337.5 Crs (Mar-26) vs ₹116.9 Crs (Mar-25), Inventories ₹112.0 Crs vs ₹39.9 Crs and Short Term Loans & Advances ₹209.0 Crs vs ₹27.1 Crs, against Cash and Bank Balances of ₹11.7 Crs.
- Total consolidated Equity was ₹405.4 Crs at Mar-26 (vs ₹179.5 Crs at Mar-25) including Minority Interest of ₹150.4 Crs, against equity share capital unchanged at ₹21.4 Crs; no dividend or buyback policy is stated.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Acquisition / structure] The consolidated entity now differs materially from the standalone one — consolidated Q1 FY27 revenue ₹378.8 Crs versus standalone ₹200.3 Crs, and consolidated total assets ₹1,153.3 Crs versus standalone ₹542.5 Crs — driven by the Kandoi Transport Limited acquisition and the new mining/transportation segments; readers should not read consolidated figures as the listed standalone entity's own operations.
- [Corporate history] Originally incorporated as a partnership firm "M/s Ganesh International" dated May 15, 2017; converted from partnership to private company, then "Converted from Private Company to a Public Company. Listed on NSE SME EMERGE" (2024). Earlier operating milestones listed — a Kharagpur power-coating-plant shed, a power substation project for a state electricity board, "more than 100 Kms of underground cabling of electrical cable using HDD method", securing UP Jal Jeevan Mission work, and "Crossed an annual turnover of ₹130 crores" — appear in the extract without a reliable year binding, so their individual years are not asserted here.
- [Management] Vibhoar Agrawal (Founder & CMD, with the Company since inception); Sudhir Ojha (CFO); Radheshyam Saini (Chief Technical Officer, Diploma in Civil Engineering, 24 years' experience); Rup Kumar Bhattacharya (COO, B.E. Civil 1990, "over 30 years of experience, having led ₹3,300+ crore infrastructure projects at McNally Bharat").
- [Data inconsistency] The CMD's letter and the income statement disagree slightly on the same quarter's growth rates — CMD: "Revenue increased by 109.7% YoY" and "EBITDA grew by 189.5% YoY" versus the table's 109.6% and 189.8%; and revenue is "₹378.77 crore" in the letter vs "378.8" in the table.
